risks.risk: Exact engine make/model/engine code is not readable, so compatibility and correct pricing cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/plate (usually on the block/head) plus the full label/part number sticker if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown used engine assembly with compatibility risk (worst-case: may not fit the buyer’s vehicle).

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” cannot be verified remotely without a running test.
risks.proof: Short video of the engine running from start-up to stable idle, plus an audio clip showing no knocking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven (worst-case: treat as potentially faulty/not guaranteed working).

risks.risk: “Low mileage / never opened” cannot be verified; internal wear or prior repairs may exist.
risks.proof: Photos of service/tamper indicators: seal condition around covers, bolt head condition, and any opened gaskets; plus compression test results if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher-wear used condition (worst-case: assume unknown mileage and possible prior work).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incomplete assembly (e.g., alternator, starter, sensors, ECU, turbo/AC components depending on what’s included).
risks.proof: A full inventory photo laid out (or a checklist photo) showing exactly what is included with the engine package.
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine-only/incomplete package risk (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/part number plate on the block/head (photo).
Video of the engine running (start-up + idle) with audio (to assess knock).
Diagnostic scan report (OBD) or any test sheet showing fault codes cleared/none present.
Photos showing tamper/seal condition and gasket edges to support “never opened.”
A photo/list of all included parts (what accessories/sensors/ECU are included or not).
response.reason: The photo shows an engine assembly, but the exact identity (engine code/model) and the seller’s “tested/working, no knock, low mileage, never opened” claims are not verifiable from the image alone. Without engine code and proof of running/test, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
